div.head: Quadr Arg 10
div.ab: Hic uero felicibus sublimatus auspiciis, magno ueritatis et iusticiæ documento rexit imperium, et quicquid in humanis hodie malum uidetur ac miserum, fortiori felicitatis euertit augmento, sic ad omnia uirtutum ornamenta compositus, ut, quod mirum est, communi omnium uoto regnaret.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 533 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

seg.hi: vielleicht das unter Eadward III. abgeschaffte, unter Heinrich I. wieder drückende Dänengeld?

note.seg: perhaps the Danegeld, abolished under Eadward III and oppressive again under Henry I?

div.ab: He indeed, raised up under happy auspices, ruled the empire with great proof of truth and justice, and whatever seems evil and wretched in human affairs today he overturned with a stronger increase of happiness, so composed for all the ornaments of the virtues that, what is wonderful, he reigned by the common wish of all.
